name: How do ceramic, natural stone, and glass backsplash tiles compare?

mainEntity.name: How do ceramic, natural stone, and glass backsplash tiles compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic and porcelain tile offer high stain resistance and require minimal maintenance, making them practical behind cooking ranges and sinks. Natural stone such as marble or travertine provides an upscale look, but it is porous and requires regular sealing to prevent grease and water stains. Glass tile delivers a reflective surface that brightens dark corners, though it demands precise cutting and smooth wall prep because flaws can show through. Your choice should balance how often you cook with the amount of ongoing surface upkeep you want to handle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic and porcelain resist stains with little upkeep. Natural stone requires ongoing sealing to prevent grease absorption. Glass tile reflects light well but demands meticulous wall prep.
